ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Desktop Background Change Via Registry
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects registry value settings that would replace the user's desktop background.
This is a common technique used by malware to change the desktop background to a ransom note or other image.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*Control\\ Panel\\\\Desktop.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\ActiveDesktop.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System.*")) AND ((registry_path = RGX("NoChangingWallpaper$") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Wallpaper$") OR (registry_path = RGX("\\\\WallpaperStyle$") AND Details = 2)) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$"))
